children: New Delhi, Sept. 16 -- Zee Entertainment share price jumped 8% in intraday trade on the BSE on Wednesday, 16 September, reflecting healthy buying interest after the recent correction. Zee Entertainment shares opened at Rs.77.80 against their previous close of Rs.77.40 and jumped as much as 8% to an intraday high of Rs.83.62, looking set to snap its four-day losing run.
